name: @napplet/cli
description: Standalone CLI for creating, configuring, testing, and deploying napplets

tasks.build: deno task check && deno task compile:linux-x86_64 && deno task compile:linux-aarch64 && deno task compile:darwin-x86_64 && deno task compile:darwin-aarch64 && deno task compile:windows-x86_64
tasks.compile:linux-x86_64: deno compile --engine quickjs --exclude-unused-npm --no-check --node-modules-dir=none --allow-read --allow-write --allow-run --allow-env --allow-net --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu --output dist/napplet-linux-x86_64 src/standalone.ts
tasks.compile:linux-aarch64: deno compile --engine quickjs --exclude-unused-npm --no-check --node-modules-dir=none --allow-read --allow-write --allow-run --allow-env --allow-net --target aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu --output dist/napplet-linux-aarch64 src/standalone.ts
tasks.compile:darwin-x86_64: deno compile --engine quickjs --exclude-unused-npm --no-check --node-modules-dir=none --allow-read --allow-write --allow-run --allow-env --allow-net --target x86_64-apple-darwin --output dist/napplet-darwin-x86_64 src/standalone.ts
tasks.compile:darwin-aarch64: deno compile --engine quickjs --exclude-unused-npm --no-check --node-modules-dir=none --allow-read --allow-write --allow-run --allow-env --allow-net --target aarch64-apple-darwin --output dist/napplet-darwin-aarch64 src/standalone.ts
tasks.compile:windows-x86_64: deno compile --engine quickjs --exclude-unused-npm --no-check --node-modules-dir=none --allow-read --allow-write --allow-run --allow-env --allow-net --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --output dist/napplet-windows-x86_64.exe src/standalone.ts
